# BuildspaceLabs

> BuildspaceLabs is India's AI-native product studio and engineering lab for enterprises worldwide.

BuildspaceLabs builds custom AI solutions, intelligent automation systems, and production-ready software. It is operated by Vruoom and works across logistics, real estate and proptech, healthcare and medtech, hardware and IoT, fintech, SaaS and customer support, legal tech, and adjacent B2B software teams.

## Services

- Custom AI Builds: bespoke AI systems and enterprise software built from scratch, end-to-end.
- Ready-to-Deploy AI Products: pre-built AI products integrated into a client stack within a short launch window.
- Fractional CTO: senior engineering leadership embedded with a client's team.

## Products and case studies

- Churn Radar: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/churn-radar - AI customer-success platform that flags at-risk B2B accounts before they churn and prescribes the save-play to run.
- ShortList: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/shortlist - AI recruiting screener that reads applications, scores candidates against the role, and hands recruiters a ranked shortlist with drafted outreach.
- AP Copilot: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/ap-copilot - AI accounts-payable copilot that reads invoices, matches them to POs, and routes clean approvals.
- AI Clinical Notes: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/sanad - AI-powered medical scribe that listens to doctor-patient conversations and writes clinical notes automatically.
- Focuscare: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/focuscare - physiotherapy consultation automation from patient onboarding to AI-generated notes and follow-up scheduling.
- DSV Fleet Management: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/dsv-fleet-management - real-time fleet tracking and dispatching platform for vehicle, driver, and route visibility.
- Charge Pulse: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/charge-pulse - real-time EV charging station finder with GPS navigation, live availability, and traffic-aware routing.
- Low Latency Food Ordering Platform: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/food-ordering-platform - events operations platform for vendor management, order tracking, payments, and automated settlements.
- Open Vision PPE Monitoring: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/open-vision-ppe - on-premise video analytics for boundary surveillance, PPE compliance monitoring, and intrusion detection.
- Factory OS: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/factory-os - production planning and task management replacing spreadsheet workflows with automated milestone planning and SOP gate enforcement.
- AI Lease Management: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/grospace - commercial real estate lease management for lease extraction, obligation tracking, and portfolio intelligence.
- AI-Native Real Estate Fund: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/ai-native-real-estate-fund - AI agents for deal scouting, underwriting, outreach, and structuring across distressed properties and land parcels.
- Captcha-Resilient ATS Agent: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/ai-job-automation - job application automation across Lever, Greenhouse, and Workday with CAPTCHA-resilient flows.
- Investor Update Drafter: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/investor-update-drafter - AI-drafted monthly investor updates generated from live metrics with tone controls and send history.
- Sales Call Coach: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/sales-call-coach - call review with AI-flagged moments, transcripts, and rep scorecards.
- Inbox Zero: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/inbox-zero - AI email triage with smart lanes, drafted replies, and a daily debrief.
- Support Pulse: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/support-pulse - AI ticket triage and drafted replies for SaaS support teams.
- Brief Forge: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/brief-forge - contract review AI for extracting, scoring, and redlining contracts.
- Patient Front Desk: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/patient-front-desk - AI receptionist for clinic intake, scheduling, and insurance verification.
- Reply Rail: https://buildspacelabs.com/product/reply-rail - AI-drafted Google, Yelp, and Facebook review responses for local businesses.
